svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light;

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(79, 70, 229), rgb(162, 154, 255));
